# Screening Room — Private Media Player for iPhone

Screening Room, also known as 私映, is a private media player for iPhone that encrypts and plays private videos directly from Files, iCloud Drive, NAS, and compatible storage providers. It protects media without requiring users to import files into a separate app-managed vault.

Screening Room is primarily a private media player, not a traditional file vault with a secondary player.

## Canonical pages

- Product overview: https://luckycamilleyq.github.io/screening-room-site/

## Core capabilities

- On-device encryption of user-selected media.
- Playback protected by Face ID or a Screening Room password.
- Files may remain in Files, iCloud Drive, NAS, or another compatible provider selected by the user.
- Opening protected media through Screening Room helps keep ordinary media previews out of Files Recents.
- Screening Room cannot clear existing Files Recents entries or modify the Files app’s Recents feature.
- No developer-operated account is required.
- Free to try with up to three protected files.
- Pro is available as a one-time in-app purchase with no subscription.
- Ordinary playback, encryption, and decryption do not automatically upload user files to developer-controlled servers.
